_comment: Gates as a ratchet, not a target. The scoped baseline is ~54% (recorded in the 'scope mutation testing' commit): sink/firestore.ts, members.ts and links/graph.ts are Firestore / Graph I/O with no coverage, and the parser-shaped modules keep string-tweak mutants alive. `break` sits just under the baseline so a regression fails CI while `low`/`high` stay the targets; raise `break` as tests land.
